before.zh: 癸未，賈后使太醫令程據和毒藥。
before.en: On guimao the empress had Cheng Ju, Director of Imperial Physicians, prepare poison.
before.literal: On the day guimao Empress Jia had the Director of Imperial Physicians Cheng Ju compound poison.

after.zh: 癸未，賈后使太醫令程據和毒藥。
after.en: On guiwei the empress had Cheng Ju, Director of Imperial Physicians, prepare poison.
after.literal: On the day guiwei Empress Jia had the Director of Imperial Physicians Cheng Ju compound poison.

before.zh: 詔尚書收捕賈氏親黨，召中書監、侍中、黃門侍郎、八座皆夜入殿。
before.en: An edict ordered arrest of the Jia clan; the Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, attendants, Yellow Gate Gentlemen, and Eight Seats were summoned at night.
before.literal: An edict ordered the Masters of Writing to arrest the Jia kin; the Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, attendants, Yellow Gate Gentlemen, and the Eight Seats were all summoned into the hall at night.

after.zh: 詔尚書收捕賈氏親黨，召中書監、侍中、黃門侍郎、八座皆夜入殿。
after.en: An edict ordered arrest of the Jia clan; the Secretariat Supervisor, attendants, Yellow Gate Gentlemen, and Eight Seats were summoned at night.
after.literal: An edict ordered the Masters of Writing to arrest the Jia kin; the Secretariat Supervisor, attendants, Yellow Gate Gentlemen, and the Eight Seats were all summoned into the hall at night.

before.zh: 秀為中書令，威權振朝廷，天下皆事秀而無求於倫。
before.en: Xiu became Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; power radiated from him; the realm served Xiu, not Lun.
before.literal: Xiu was Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; his authority shook the court; the realm served Xiu and sought nothing from Lun.

after.zh: 秀為中書令，威權振朝廷，天下皆事秀而無求於倫。
after.en: Xiu became Secretariat Director; power radiated from him; the realm served Xiu, not Lun.
after.literal: Xiu was Secretariat Director; his authority shook the court; the realm served Xiu and sought nothing from Lun.

before.zh: 倫官屬皆隱樹而立，每樹輒中數百箭，自辰至未，中書令陳淮，徽之兄也，欲應允，言於帝曰：「宜遣白虎幡以解鬥。」
before.en: Lun's staff hid behind trees, each tree studded with hundreds of arrows. From chen to wei, Chen Huai, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Hui's elder brother, wished to aid Yun and told the emperor: "Send the white tiger banner to stop the fighting."
before.literal: Lun's staff all hid behind trees to stand; each tree received hundreds of arrows. From the hour chen to wei, the Supervisor of the Masters of Writing Chen Huai—Hui's elder brother—wished to support Yun and said to the emperor: "The white tiger banner should be sent to halt the fighting."

after.zh: 倫官屬皆隱樹而立，每樹輒中數百箭，自辰至未，中書令陳淮，徽之兄也，欲應允，言於帝曰：「宜遣白虎幡以解鬥。」
after.en: Lun's staff hid behind trees, each tree studded with hundreds of arrows. From chen to wei, Chen Huai, Secretariat Director and Hui's elder brother, wished to aid Yun and told the emperor: "Send the white tiger banner to stop the fighting."
after.literal: Lun's staff all hid behind trees to stand; each tree received hundreds of arrows. From the hour chen to wei, the Secretariat Director Chen Huai—Hui's elder brother—wished to support Yun and said to the emperor: "The white tiger banner should be sent to halt the fighting."

before.zh: 允不之覺，開陣內之，下車受詔；
before.en: Yun did not detect the fraud and opened his ranks. Yin dismounted to receive the edict;
before.literal: Yun did not perceive the deception and opened his ranks to admit him; Yin dismounted to receive the edict;

after.zh: 允不之覺，開陣內之，下車受詔；
after.en: Yun did not detect the fraud and opened his ranks. Yun dismounted to receive the edict;
after.literal: Yun did not perceive the deception and opened his ranks to admit him; Yun dismounted to receive the edict;

before.zh: 初，孫秀嘗為小吏，事黃門郎潘岳，岳屢撻之。
before.en: Earlier Xiu had served as a petty clerk under Pan Yue, Yellow Gate Gentleman, whom he had often flogged.
before.literal: Earlier Sun Xiu had once been a petty clerk serving the Yellow Gate Gentleman Pan Yue; Yue often flogged him.

after.zh: 初，孫秀嘗為小吏，事黃門郎潘岳，岳屢撻之。
after.en: Earlier Xiu had served as a petty clerk under Pan Yue, Yellow Gate Gentleman, who had often flogged him.
after.literal: Earlier Sun Xiu had once been a petty clerk serving the Yellow Gate Gentleman Pan Yue; Yue often flogged him.

before.zh: 相國倫收淮南王母弟吳王晏，欲殺之。
before.en: Lun arrested Yan, Prince of Wu, younger brother of Yun's mother, intending to kill him.
before.literal: Chancellor Lun arrested the Prince of Wu Yan, younger brother of the Prince of Huainan's mother, intending to kill him.

after.zh: 相國倫收淮南王母弟吳王晏，欲殺之。
after.en: Lun arrested Yan, Prince of Wu, Yun's younger brother by the same mother, intending to kill him.
after.literal: Chancellor Lun arrested the Prince of Wu Yan, the Prince of Huainan's younger brother by the same mother, intending to kill him.

before.zh: 李庠帥妹婿李含、天水任回、上官昌、扶風李攀、始平費他、氐苻成、隗伯等四千騎歸廞。
before.en: Li Xiu led Li Han, Ren Hui, Shangguan Chang, Li Pan, Fei Ta, Fu Cheng, Wei Bo, and four thousand horsemen to join Xin.
before.literal: Li Xiu led his brothers-in-law Li Han of Tianshui, Ren Hui, Shangguan Chang, Li Pan of Fufeng, Fei Ta of Shiping, the Di Fu Cheng, and Wei Bo and others with four thousand horsemen to join Xin.

after.zh: 李庠帥妹婿李含、天水任回、上官昌、扶風李攀、始平費他、氐苻成、隗伯等四千騎歸廞。
after.en: Li Xiang led his younger sister's husband Li Han, Ren Hui of Tianshui, Shangguan Chang, Li Pan of Fufeng, Fei Ta of Shiping, the Di Fu Cheng, Wei Bo, and others—four thousand horsemen in all—to join Xin.
after.literal: Li Xiang led his younger sister's husband Li Han, Ren Hui of Tianshui, Shangguan Chang, Li Pan of Fufeng, Fei Ta of Shiping, the Di Fu Cheng, Wei Bo, and others—four thousand horsemen in all—to join Xin.

before.zh: 廞以庠為威寇將軍，封陽泉亭侯，委以心膂，使招合六郡壯勇至萬餘人，以斷北道。
before.en: Xin made Xiu General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan, trusted him deeply, and had him gather more than ten thousand braves of six commanderies to block the northern road.
before.literal: Xin made Xiu General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan Pavilion, entrusted him as close confidant, and had him gather braves of the six commanderies to more than ten thousand to cut the northern road.

after.zh: 廞以庠為威寇將軍，封陽泉亭侯，委以心膂，使招合六郡壯勇至萬餘人，以斷北道。
after.en: Xin made Li Xiang General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan, trusted him deeply, and had him gather more than ten thousand braves of six commanderies to block the northern road.
after.literal: Xin made Li Xiang General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan Pavilion, entrusted him as close confidant, and had him gather braves of the six commanderies to more than ten thousand to cut the northern road.
